title: CBIZ Recognized as a Leading Accounting and Advisory Services Provider by PA Legal Community
summary: CBIZ earns top honors in The Legal Intelligencer’s 2026 Best Of survey, reinforcing its trusted advisory role in Pennsylvania’s legal community.
body_markdown:
CBIZ is proud to be recognized by the Pennsylvania attorney audience of *The Legal Intelligencer* as a First-Place winner in the[2026 “Best Of” readers’ survey](https://www2.cbiz.com/l/42462/2026-08-21/ftnrth) . This marks the fifth consecutive year CBIZ has been recognized, underscoring the continued trust Pennsylvania’s legal community places in our team.


This year, CBIZ earned first-place and Hall of Fame recognition in the Expert Witness: Economic, Forensic Accounting, Accounting Firm and Business Accounting Firm categories. CBIZ also received second-place honors in the Expert Witness and Litigation Valuation Provider categories.


These awards reflect our record of excellence and consistent service to attorneys, law firms and legal professionals across Pennsylvania. We are honored by this continued recognition and grateful to the attorneys and legal professionals who voted for CBIZ. Congratulations to our colleagues whose dedication, expertise and client-focused service made this achievement possible.
